name: Norway-Denmark
alt: Norway and Denmark under Magnus I
Union of Norway and Denmark under Magnus the Good

predecessors.name: Denmark-England
predecessors.text: Denmark, which Magnus took when Harthacnut died in 1042

successors.name: Old Kingdom of Norway
successors.text: Norway under Harald Hardrada (M1: 'his kingdom was split between Harald Hardrada in Norway and Sweyn Estridsson in Denmark')

ledger.x: 1042: Magnus the Good of Norway is crowned king of Denmark as well.
1043: Sweyn Estridsson returns with the Wends and Magnus defeats them at Lyrskov Heath.
Late 1046: Sweyn is driven out of Denmark.
25 October 1047: Magnus dies and his two kingdoms part.

wars.name: Magnus the Good against Sweyn Estridsson and the Wends
wars.outcome: Magnus won at Lyrskov Heath in 1043 and had driven Sweyn out of Denmark by late 1046; after Magnus died in October 1047 Denmark went to Sweyn.

certainty.note: Two kingdoms under one king; their coasts and inland frontiers are unsurveyed, and the Wend and Swedish frontiers are approximate.
